subject: 英C
japanese: 弟は昨日、飛行機の写真を撮ることを楽しみました。
modelAnswer: My brother enjoyed taking pictures of airplanes yesterday.
acceptedAnswers: Yesterday, my brother enjoyed taking pictures of airplanes.
hints: take pictures of ～：～の写真を撮る
explanation: enjoy の後には動名詞を置く。

subject: 英C
japanese: このチームは12人の選手で構成されています。
modelAnswer: This team consists of twelve players.
acceptedAnswers: The team consists of twelve players.
hints: 主語が三人称単数なら consists
explanation: consist of ～ は「～から成る」。

subject: 英C
japanese: そのレストランはとても豪華な内装でした。
modelAnswer: The restaurant had a gorgeous interior.
acceptedAnswers: That restaurant had a gorgeous interior.
explanation: gorgeous は「豪華な・華やかな」。

subject: 英C
japanese: 新しい図書館は市役所の隣にあります。
modelAnswer: The new library is located next to the city hall.
acceptedAnswers: The new library is located beside the city hall.
explanation: be located は「位置している」。

subject: 英C
japanese: その試合の一番の見どころは最後のゴールでした。
modelAnswer: The highlight of the game was the final goal.
acceptedAnswers: The final goal was the highlight of the game.
explanation: highlight は「最も印象的な場面・見どころ」。

subject: 英C
japanese: その町の人口は約3万人です。
modelAnswer: The town has a population of about 30,000.
acceptedAnswers: The population of the town is about 30,000.
explanation: population は「人口」。

subject: 英C
japanese: 私は来年、絶対にこの大会に参加したいです。
modelAnswer: I definitely want to participate in this tournament next year.
acceptedAnswers: Next year, I definitely want to participate in this tournament.
explanation: definitely は「絶対に・間違いなく」。

subject: 英C
japanese: 留学生と交流することは私にとって大切です。
modelAnswer: It is important for me to interact with exchange students.
acceptedAnswers: For me, it is important to interact with exchange students.
hints: It is + 形容詞 + for 人 + to不定詞
explanation: interact with ～ は「～と交流する」。

subject: 英C
japanese: この静かな部屋は勉強するのに理想的です。
modelAnswer: This quiet room is ideal for studying.
acceptedAnswers: This quiet room is an ideal place to study.
explanation: ideal for ～ は「～に理想的」。

subject: 英C
japanese: その映画は私に子どもの頃の思い出を忘れさせました。
modelAnswer: The movie made me forget my childhood memories.
acceptedAnswers: That movie made me forget my childhood memories.
hints: make + 人 + 動詞の原形
childhood memories：子どもの頃の思い出
explanation: 使役の make の後には動詞の原形を置く。

subject: 論表
japanese: 私は将来、外国の会社で働きたいと思っています。
modelAnswer: I hope to work for a foreign company in the future.
acceptedAnswers: In the future, I hope to work for a foreign company.
explanation: hope to ～ は「～したいと思う」。

subject: 論表
japanese: 毎日早起きすることは私にとって簡単ではありません。
modelAnswer: It is not easy for me to get up early every day.
acceptedAnswers: It's not easy for me to get up early every day.
hints: It is + 形容詞 + for 人 + to不定詞
explanation: 形式主語 It を使う構文。

subject: 論表
japanese: 私は新しい友達を作ることが大切だと気づきました。
modelAnswer: I found it important to make new friends.
acceptedAnswers: I found it important to make some new friends.
hints: find + it + 形容詞 + to不定詞
explanation: it は形式目的語。

subject: 論表
japanese: 彼は妹を迎えに行くために駅へ走りました。
modelAnswer: He ran to the station to pick up his sister.
acceptedAnswers: He ran to the station to pick up his younger sister.
hints: 目的を表す to不定詞
run to the station / pick up
explanation: to pick up ～ は「～を迎えに行くために」。

subject: 論表
japanese: 私はその知らせを聞いて驚きました。
modelAnswer: I was surprised to hear the news.
acceptedAnswers: I was surprised to hear that news.
hints: 感情の原因を表す to不定詞
explanation: be surprised to hear ～ は「～を聞いて驚く」。

subject: 論表
japanese: 先生は私たちに教室を掃除するように頼みました。
modelAnswer: The teacher asked us to clean the classroom.
acceptedAnswers: Our teacher asked us to clean the classroom.
explanation: ask someone to do は「人に～するよう頼む」。

subject: 論表
japanese: 父は私が一人で旅行することを許してくれました。
modelAnswer: My father allowed me to travel alone.
acceptedAnswers: My dad allowed me to travel alone.
explanation: allow someone to do は「人が～するのを許す」。

subject: 論表
japanese: 私は隣の部屋で誰かが笑っているのを聞きました。
modelAnswer: I heard someone laughing in the next room.
acceptedAnswers: I heard someone laugh in the next room.
hints: hear + 人 + 動詞の-ing形 / 原形
explanation: 知覚動詞 hear は動詞の-ing形と原形の両方を取れるが、捉える場面のニュアンスが異なる。

subject: 論表
japanese: コーチは私たちに練習後、自由に休ませてくれました。
modelAnswer: The coach let us rest after practice.
acceptedAnswers: Our coach let us rest after practice.
hints: let + 人 + 動詞の原形
explanation: let の後は to を付けない。

subject: 論表
japanese: 私は弟に荷物を運んでもらいました。
modelAnswer: I had my brother carry my bags.
acceptedAnswers: I had my younger brother carry my bags.
hints: have + 人 + 動詞の原形
explanation: 使役の have の後は動詞の原形。
